title: Genealogies
summary: Genealogies traced family lines, inheritance, priestly eligibility, royal claims, covenant memory, and identity.
background: Genealogies can feel distant to modern readers, but they mattered for family, tribe, land, priesthood, kingship, and messianic hope.
teachingHelp: When teaching genealogies, show why names and lineage matter to covenant history and God’s faithfulness.
